title: Orders over 200
statementMd:
List orders whose total value exceeds 200. Show order id and total rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `order_id`, `total`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT oi.order_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total FROM order_items oi GROUP BY oi.order_id HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > 200;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
